baslik: Simple Past Tense: Negative and Interrogative (?) Forms
paragraflar: Simple Past Negative: Tüm öznelerden sonra 'didn't + V1 (yalın fiil)' kullanılır (He didn't move, She didn't win); isim/sıfat cümlelerinde wasn't / weren't gelir.
Simple Past Questions (?): '(Wh-) + did + Subject + V1?' kalıbı kullanılır (When did he graduate?, Why did she move to Paris?); doğmak fiili 'Where/When was he born?' ile sorulur.
